policies.title: Admin endpoints check the caller's role
policies.statement: Every endpoint in the admin API group (served at /api:admin) must call the role-check function check_admin_role as its first statement, passing the logged-in user. The role check allows only users whose role is 'admin' or 'support_lead'. An endpoint that cannot call it first is not public: it must not reach data until the check has run.

rules.title: Admin endpoints call the role check first

policies.title: Tenant reads and writes filter by org_id
policies.statement: Every read and write of the tenants table must constrain org_id in its where clause, so that a request only touches tenants belonging to one org. A row picked by id alone is not allowed. A statement that cannot filter by org_id is not exempt: change it to filter by org_id first.

rules.title: tenants reads and writes constrain org_id
